introduction: Help Xolot with the two weapons and hidden heart while exploring the myconid caverns, fungus garden, spring and web caves as distinct progression leads.
orientation: The cavern entrance connects south and west to the registered Underdark. Find Xolot deeper in the caverns when present; merely entering the zone does not expose an unmet giver’s request.
Ask Xolot gravf, valdrak or acopiltaczet. These are three conversation families about the spider leaders, rather than three completed quests. Use the exact valid acopiltaczet keyword.

Gravf carries the blood soaked longsword, Acopiltaczet the blood stained claymore, and ValDrak the heart of living darkness. Each is a different exact item; the heart is hidden stock. Source battles, reveal and recovery remain separate.

Carry one of each requested item loose and offer all three together. Supplied exact items remain legal without remembered dialogue, personal combat, original recovery, a purchase or garden and spring prerequisites.

One accepted return has currency and experience terms, followed by Xolot’s departure. Actual reward recipients, level limits and settlement need their own qualification; narrative ritual and freedom do not create separate completed quests.

The fungus garden has purple and speckled food and its own myconid community. Food recovery and admitted eating are optional leads; their prose does not prove a hallucination, poison, cure or level gain.
Wejtew’s spring shop has food, a backpack and other declared goods. Shopping, admitted spring use and the spring’s current travel policy are separate from Xolot’s request.

The narrow single-file passage, dismal caves, web-cave creatures, ancient and paranoid myconids, Muscaria and Xolot’s zombie follower are wider leads. Future rescue, restoration, service or ritual stories need explicit participant and outcome policy.

stories.title: Return the three spider items to Xolot
stories.summary: Bring the blood soaked longsword, blood stained claymore and heart of living darkness together for one return. The accepted bundle does not prove personal kills, original recovery, a performed ritual or restored community behavior.

steps.text: Carry the blood soaked longsword loose
steps.hint: The exact blood soaked longsword is stocked on Gravf in the blood-stained chamber. A supplied exact item also fits. Carry it loose; held, worn or nested stock does not prepare this offering. Personal combat and original recovery are separate outcomes.

steps.text: Carry the blood stained claymore loose
steps.hint: The exact blood stained claymore is stocked on Acopiltaczet in the chamber of swaying shadows. A supplied exact item also fits. Carry it loose; held, worn or nested stock does not prepare this offering. Personal combat and original recovery are separate outcomes.

steps.text: Carry the heart of living darkness loose
steps.hint: The exact heart of living darkness is stocked on ValDrak in the bone-filled chamber. The heart is hidden; search the appropriate source container or corpse when recovering it, subject to actual visibility and access. A supplied exact item also fits. Carry it loose; held, worn or nested stock does not prepare this offering. Personal combat and original recovery are separate outcomes.

Offer all three different exact loose items together to Xolot when present. This is one accepted return with currency and experience terms, followed by his departure. Earlier conversation, personal kills, original recovery, purchases, food, spring use and a completed ritual are not native prerequisites.
